description: Lashonek wears a long dark blue textured court coat with dark brown fur collar and cuffs, narrow rust-pink and cream geometric embroidered borders, a cream embroidered tunic, patterned rust and navy woven sash with a hanging fringed end, two round bronze upper chest brooches joined by a cord, muted brown trousers and dark brown knee boots. Both hands hang visibly at his sides.
